title: Sprint unified evaluation row (sec B3)
description: One row of the sprint's unified evaluation table (plan docs/SPRINT_COMPLETION_PLAN_MATAN_MAHMOOD.md sec B3). It EXTENDS schemas/evaluation_result.schema.json without breaking it: every row valid under this schema carries the sprint fields below, and legacy evaluation_result rows remain valid because their required fields are optional-superset here. Field names follow the GCG-pipeline convention (strongreject_*). Report numerator/denominator per split; never mix AdvBench and ClearHarm denominators.
$comment: Lineage: this schema is the sprint-B3 superset of schemas/evaluation_result.schema.json. It deliberately does NOT `$ref`/`allOf` the legacy schema, because that schema requires legacy field names (condition, target_response, decoding_config, seed, strongreject_score) that a unified row expresses under new names (response, generation_seed, strongreject_raw). additionalProperties:true keeps every legacy field valid as a pass-through, so legacy evaluation_result rows augmented with the sprint fields still validate here, and the legacy schema continues to validate old files unchanged. Nothing about evaluation_result.schema.json is modified.

task_id.description: Stable manifest id, e.g. advbench_full_0001 or clearharm_<12hex>.

source_dataset.description: Originating dataset. Denominators must never mix across these.

split.description: Manifest split the task_id belongs to.

attack_family.description: Family of the attack producing this row.

attack_setting.description: Scope over which the attack/suffix was optimized.

optimizer.description: Optimizer used (e.g. gcg, mac, rloo, soft_prompt); null for no-attack rows.

objective.description: Optimization objective, e.g. prefix_ce, behavioral, reinforce, proxy_ce.

objective_version.description: Versioned objective/reward tag for reproducibility (plan sec 6.5/6.6).

optimization_seed.description: Seed used during trigger optimization; null if no optimization.

generation_seed.description: Decoding seed for the evaluated generation (0 for greedy).

checkpoint_step.description: Optimizer step / checkpoint the evaluated suffix came from; null if N/A.

suffix.description: Optimized suffix text; empty/null for no-suffix or non-suffix attacks.

prompt_token_length.description: Tokenized length of the full input prompt fed to the model.

response.description: Full free-form generation (answer channel; excludes reasoning if separated).

reasoning.description: Reasoning / thinking-channel text for CoT models; null if none or not separated.

refusal_label.description: True if the response is a refusal (refusal classifier / heuristic).

secondary_judge_score.description: Score from a secondary/independent judge for agreement checks.

exact_prefix_match.description: Response begins with the exact target_prefix string.

semantic_prefix_match.description: Response semantically matches the target prefix.

answer_present.description: A non-empty answer channel was produced (relevant for thinking models).

think_closed.description: The reasoning/think block was properly closed (e.g. </think>).

degenerate.description: Generation was degenerate (empty, repetition loop, or truncated garbage).

error_type.description: Error category if the row failed to evaluate cleanly; null/none on success.
